tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Ocean Blue. Primary brand color: primary buttons, CTAs, active states, middle cloud of the mark. Not for text on light grounds (2.8:1 on white); use link there.

tokens.name: brand-aqua
tokens.usage: Aqua Cyan. Front cloud of the mark, highlights and accents on dark grounds (11:1 on brand-deep). Decorative only on light grounds.

tokens.name: brand-purple
tokens.usage: Back cloud of the mark. Accent fills, illustrations, tags. Use as a fill, not as text on dark grounds.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Deep purple. Start of the dark gradient, dark cards, app icon background, dark text on light marketing grounds.

tokens.name: brand-deepest
tokens.usage: Deepest indigo. End of the dark gradient, text on brand-blue buttons (7:1).

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: App and site page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, menus, navbar. Pair with shadow-card.

tokens.name: gradient-start
tokens.usage: First stop of hero and splash gradients (135deg, gradient-start to gradient-end).

tokens.name: gradient-end
tokens.usage: Last stop of hero and splash gradients. Light mode: white to light aqua; dark mode: deep purple to indigo.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-page, surface-raised and the gradients (17:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, placeholders on surface-page and surface-raised (4.6:1 light, 7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-blue and brand-aqua fills (7:1 on brand-blue).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links and blue text. Light uses a darker blue so it reaches 4.8:1 on white; dark uses brand-blue (6.4:1 on brand-deep).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline on every interactive element (3:1 or more on both surfaces).

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and outline buttons (3:1 or more against surface-raised).

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only, never the only cue for a control.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headlines on the site and splash screens.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Lead paragraph under a hero headline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Default reading text for apps and the site.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, form labels, nav items.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text, table cells, secondary info.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, footnotes. Use ink-muted at most.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default padding, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between groups within a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between page sections in apps.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space between sections on the marketing site.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, avatars, toggles. Echoes the round cloud shapes.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Soft shadow on cards and the navbar in both modes.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs.
